evidence.title: Evil Charts — Animated React Chart Components for shadcn/ui
GitHub - legions-developer/evilcharts: EvilCharts is an open-source chart UI website built with shadcn and Recharts, beautifully designed and handcrafted.

name: EvilCharts
summary: Animated, interactive chart components for shadcn/ui built on Recharts and Apache ECharts.
description: Free, open-source chart components for React: area, bar, line, composed and radar charts plus tooltip, legend, brush, dots and background UI, configured with a theme-aware chartConfig for labels, colors and icons. Install from the EvilCharts shadcn registry or copy the source; Recharts (SVG) and Apache ECharts engines.
contains: chart components: area, bar, line, composed, radar
UI pieces: tooltip, legend, dots, brush, background, chart config
two engines: Recharts SVG and Apache ECharts
theme-aware colors and dark mode via chartConfig
